Inside the serene walls of a Buddhist monastery what really happens? Do monks ever get angry? What is their daily life like? Who can become a monk? And what do Buddhist monks think about the Bihar elections 2025?
In this episode of Hum Bihar Ke Log, The Lallantop team Vikas Verma, Shivani Dalakoti and Amitesh visit the Chakma Buddhist Monastery in Bodh Gaya to speak with Bhikkhu Priya Pal. He shares insights on monastic life, politics, and why monks are upset with CM Nitish Kumar and recent NDA government decision about the Mahabodhi Temple.
